title: HomeFlood Premium Credits: Mitigation, Claims-Free and Package
content:
**HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies — credit rule.** Three credits exist. They are decided at issue, at each renewal, and on a rating change from an accepted Elevation Certificate.

(a) **Mitigation credit.** The mitigation credit of the tier's mitigation credit percent applies when the accepted certificate on file certifies engineered flood openings.

(b) **Claims-free credit.** The claims-free credit of the tier's claims-free credit percent applies when both of these hold:
- the customer has held Tidemark flood coverage on the property, under HomeFlood or an NFIP Dwelling Form policy, since a date on or before the start of the lookback period;
- no claim with a net payment above zero has a date of loss in the lookback period.

The lookback period is the tier's claims-free period in years, ending the day before the start of the term being rated. For example, a term starting on 1 June with a 3-year period looks back from 1 June three years earlier through 31 May of the start year.

The test counts distinct claims at the same property address, under any Tidemark residential flood policy of the customer — HomeFlood claims and NFIP Dwelling Form claims alike. A claim's net payment is its payments less its voided payments. The credit applies only when that count is zero.

(c) **Package credit.** The package credit of the tier's package credit percent applies under the property-combination rule and is recorded as the term's Excess package indicator.

(d) **Combining.** Credits are added together, never multiplied, and the sum is capped at the tier's ceiling on combined credits. A credit whose condition is not met is not applicable, not zero-rated. The capped sum is recorded as the credit percent applied to the term and is used by the rating rule.

## Status of clauses (a) and (b)

Clauses (a) and (b) are **no longer in force** as the basis for the re-rated term premium worked out when an Elevation Certificate review is completed. For every other HomeFlood rating they continue to apply as written.

## Combination table (hypothetical credit percents, cap of 15)

| Mitigation | Claims-free | Package | Sum | Credit applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 5 | 5 | 20 | 15 |
| 10 | 5 | not applicable | 15 | 15 |
| not applicable | 5 | 5 | 10 | 10 |
| not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 | 0 |

superseded_clauses: The mitigation credit of mitigation_credit_pct applies when the accepted certificate on file certifies engineered flood openings.

The claims-free credit of claims_free_credit_pct applies when the customer has held Tidemark flood coverage on the property, under HomeFlood or an NFIP Dwelling Form policy, since a date on or before the start of the lookback period and no claim with a net payment above zero has a date of loss in the lookback period (homeflood_msr_paid_claims_lookback is zero).
